category_title: Elementary students with severe behavioral disorders exhibiting high-risk aggressive and disruptive behaviors
scenario_title: Teacher-led math lesson on number properties
minimal_context: The student is participating in a 10-minute teacher-led math lesson on number properties while seated at their desk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at the whiteboard for our math lesson on number properties. Please sit quietly and look at the examples.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Twists body away from the location of the learning stimuli on the white board for more than 5 seconds) I'm not looking at that. (Starts talking to the student at the next desk)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to focus on your own assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues speaking to others while the teacher talks) Make me! (Forcefully pushes the student next to him)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Stop that right now and get back to work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up, leaving the desk so no body part touches the chair for more than 5 seconds) I'm done with this! (Shouts, raising voice beyond an average volume practiced in the class)
